# Powerex Fire Protection System

> Fire safety company based in Vasai East, Mumbai, serving India since 2010. GST-verified proprietorship (GSTIN 27ABKPY1137F1ZH) supplying, installing and maintaining fire extinguishers, alarm systems, hydrant & sprinkler systems, PPE, and delivering fire safety training.
